name: yreview
description: Review comments that live in git notes. The same comments show in the Yreview plugin for JetBrains IDEs.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Yreview runs git, and git reads the repository configuration, which can name programs.

enumDescriptions: A new comment goes to refs/notes/y-review/local and stays on this machine.
A new comment goes to refs/notes/devtools/discuss and the extension pushes it to the remote.
yreview.newComments.markdownDescription: The button that the comment box shows first. Both buttons stay available.

yreview.remote.markdownDescription: The git remote that gets the shared comments. It must be the name of a remote of the repository.

yreview.writeRefspec.markdownDescription: After a share, ask before the extension adds `refs/notes/devtools/*:refs/notes/devtools/*` to `remote.<name>.fetch`. With this box clear, the extension does not ask, and you add the line by hand.

yreview.editorMarks.markdownDescription: Show the comment threads open and color the lines that an open comment covers.

yreview.intellijKey.markdownDescription: Also bind Ctrl+Shift+G, the key of the IntelliJ plugin, to Add Review Comment while an editor has focus. It replaces Show Source Control there.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
